issue_description: The customer's washing machine stopped spinning and displays error code E21. A technician replaced the drain pump on 18 August 2026 but the issue recurred, a scheduled follow-up visit was missed, and subsequent helpline calls yielded no resolution.
The customer was double charged for her broadband plan for the month of August 2026 and it took three calls and eight days to get the issue fixed.

The customer ordered a laptop on 01 September 2026 which has not been delivered past the promised delivery date of 06 September 2026. The tracking has been stuck at the Hyderabad hub for six days and no update was provided after a query was raised with the courier partner.

The customer is unable to log into their PayWise account after a recent app update, receiving a 'Session expired' error message after entering the OTP. They are concerned because their electricity bill auto-pay is due on 20 September and they cannot verify the setup.
The customer is inquiring about the possibility of purchasing an extended warranty for their refrigerator, including details on cost, coverage, and whether the compressor is included.

The customer returned a pair of running shoes on 12 August 2026 which was received at the warehouse on 16 August 2026. Despite following up multiple times, the refund of Rs. 4,499 has not been received after more than four weeks.
